verdict.rationale: Luma documents text-to-video generation and several ways to build on a prior result rather than starting over. Modify Video V2 reshapes existing footage with Adhere, Flex and Reimagine adherence modes, Draft Mode supports cheap low-resolution passes, and Luma Agents "generate, and refine" across assets. Community posts criticize output quality but do not show iteration failing, so they lower confidence rather than create a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit docs for extending or remixing a prior generation (extend and interpolate appear only as FAQ questions), region-level edits (no masking is documented), and independent hands-on evidence of the iteration workflow.

support.subject: As a creator, I can turn a text prompt into a video clip and iterate on the result without starting from scratch each time

citations.quote: text-to-video, image-to-video, video-to-video with character reference and keyframes, Draft Mode, HDR pipeline
Modify Video V2 reshapes footage you already have.

Adhere - The output adheres very closely to the source video. This is ideal for subtle enhancements, minor retexturing, or applying a light stylistic filter without drastically altering the original content.
Agents research, generate, and refine across video, image, audio, and text
